logicalSlides.title: Compatibility and lifecycle foundations
logicalSlides.content: Compatibility and lifecycle foundations FOUNDATIONAL WORK OLM evolution builds on existing packages and operational experience. OLMv0 established lifecycle management Existing registry+v1 content shapes compatibility Operational experience informs OLMv1 Existing content and users shape lifecycle implementation.

logicalSlides.title: OLM: past, current and future
logicalSlides.content: OLM: past, current and future EVOLUTION / PLANNED / FUTURE WORK OLM feature evolution Past: OLMv0, flawed namespace-local CRD visibility assumptions, SQLite, FBC Current: OLMv1, ClusterExtension, pins, webhooks Ongoing: rollouts, config, install, migration Planned: helm+v2 and v2 schemas. Future: OCI catalog storage.

logicalSlides.title: Streamlined Installation
logicalSlides.content: Streamlined Installation Standard channel since v1.11.0 spec.serviceAccount is optional and ignored. The controller uses its own service account. Restrict ClusterExtension access with RBAC and admission policy.

logicalSlides.title: Namespace Management
logicalSlides.content: Namespace Management Experimental channel since v1.12.0 Controlled by feature gate Set spec.namespace: use an existing user-managed namespace. Omit it: OLM manages a derived namespace. Deletion removes that namespace and its contents.

logicalSlides.title: Inspect phased resource rollouts
logicalSlides.content: Inspect phased resource rollouts IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT / CONTROLLED BY FEATURE-GATE Ordered phases expose resource application and readiness progress. Apply resource groups in phase order Wait for applicable readiness checks Inspect ClusterObjectDeployment and revision status Readiness checks show which phase is waiting.

logicalSlides.title: User control of extension deployments
logicalSlides.content: User control of extension deployments IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT / CONTROLLED BY FEATURE-GATE Flexible user-defined deployment configuration. Environment variables and resource settings Placement, volumes and deployment metadata Operator-provided configuration and schemas OLM applies user choices through operator configuration.

logicalSlides.title: OLMv0 → OLMv1 migration
logicalSlides.content: OLMv0 → OLMv1 migration IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT Move operator management from OLMv0 to OLMv1. Prepare v1 catalogs from v0 CatalogSources Check and preview operator migrations Migration library with example binaries Structured output supports automation and models.

logicalSlides.title: Install a bundle directly
logicalSlides.content: Install a bundle directly IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT / CONTROLLED BY FEATURE-GATE Select a registry+v1 bundle by its OCI image reference. Use sourceType: OCIImage Set source.ociImage.ref Bypass catalog resolution Proposed in open PR #2907; controlled by BoxcutterRuntime.

logicalSlides.title: Planned Helm content support
logicalSlides.content: Planned Helm content support PLANNED / helm+v2 The rendering contract targets deterministic chart behavior. Chart and values produce managed manifests Allow-listed features support reproducible rendering helm+v2 identifies the content representation Standard chart artifacts use a defined rendering contract.

logicalSlides.title: Catalog performance and content types
logicalSlides.content: Catalog performance and content types PLANNED / FUTURE WORK Design for lower catalog-processing cost and additional content types. Lower duplicated CSV metadata Direct version fields reduce property traversal Typed registry+v1 and helm+v2 content File-based catalogs remain the established foundation.

logicalSlides.title: Shared lifecycle logic in library-olm
logicalSlides.content: Shared lifecycle logic in library-olm IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT Reuse lifecycle logic through a library with explicit contracts. Share migration checks and workflow logic Exercise current development examples Record expected results in reusable fixtures Examples and fixtures make supported behavior concrete.
